items.title: Adobe (ADBE) Expands Its AI Partnership and Workspace Reach
items.summary: Adobe (NasdaqGS: ADBE) and Google announced an expanded partnership that more deeply links their creative and productivity platforms. Acrobat is set to be embedded inside Google Workspace tools such as Google Drive and Gmail for document viewing and editing. Google's AI models will be integrated into Adobe Firefly, Photoshop, Premiere and Adobe Express, with joint work between Adobe and Google DeepMind on new AI image editing features. items.title: What Could Walt Disney (DIS) AI Push Mean For Its Creative Future?
items.summary: Adobe and Walt Disney (NYSE:DIS) announced a new multi-year alliance to deploy AI tools for Disney creatives on 9 November 2026. The partnership will bring Adobe AI software into Disney film, TV, parks, cruise development and marketing workflows. Disney creative teams are expected to use Adobe tools for script development support, visual effects workflows and content localization.
